research_question: Which force-directed layout technique restores the v1 dashboard's interactive term/label/platform co-occurrence network after the unified dashboard's regression of not loading d3-lite-force.js, while keeping the existing label-collision-avoidance algorithm, accessibility hooks, and self-contained constraint?
memory_hits: library-version-manifest.json finding #1 (critical): unified dashboard does not load d3-lite-force.js
tools/audit_html_report_playwright.py already has network label overlap detection
Original v1 dashboard loads the script via <script src='assets/d3-lite-force.js'></script>
verified_facts: reports/assets/d3-lite-force.js is an 89-line vendored mini-D3 force layout helper (not real D3)
The helper exposes window.d3LiteForce.layout(nodes, links, opts) and runs synchronously
The helper sets window.d3 = window.d3 || { version: 'd3-lite-force-local' } (does not overwrite real D3)
The original dashboard calls window.d3LiteForce?.layout(nodes, edges, {width, height, charge:-390, iterations:230})
Without the helper, the code falls back to a circular layout (nodes placed by index on a circle)
The unified dashboard's generator at scripts/generate_adintel_dashboard.py did not include the <script> tag
Playwright audit confirmed: d3_lite_force_loaded was False before fix, True after fix
Playwright audit confirmed: node coordinates changed from circular (cos/sin pattern) to force-directed (non-circular positions)
reasonable_inferences: The 89-line helper is sufficient for the current ~100-node / 260-edge network (O(N^2) charge at N=100 = 10K ops per iteration x 230 iterations = 2.3M ops, runs in <50ms)
The helper would need upgrading to real d3-force (with Barnes-Hut) if the network exceeds ~500 nodes
unresolved_uncertainties: The exact charge and iteration parameters that produce the best layout for this specific corpus were inherited from v1 without re-tuning; they may not be optimal for the unified dashboard's slightly different viewport size
official_documentation: W3C SVG Accessibility / ARIA roles for charts
D3 force-layout documentation (for theoretical reference, even though we use a lite version)
primary_research: Heer, J. The Barnes-Hut Approximation (for force-directed layout theory)
comparable_projects: D3 d3-force (full) — ISC license — ~12KB vendored, but depends on d3-quadtree, d3-dispatch, d3-timer
Cytoscape.js — MIT license — ~400KB, canvas-rendered, too heavy for self-contained
Project's own d3-lite-force.js — 89 lines, vendored, sufficient for current scale
candidate_techniques: Original: load d3-lite-force.js with no guard (rejected — silent failure was the original regression)
Minimal restore: load d3-lite-force.js + add visible load-failure guard (SELECTED)
Alternative: vendor real d3-force ~12KB and rewrite renderTermNetwork (rejected — unnecessary at current scale)
selected_technique: Load the existing d3-lite-force.js in the unified dashboard via <script src='../assets/d3-lite-force.js'></script>, plus a visible load-failure guard in renderTermNetwork() that displays a role='alert' warning if window.d3LiteForce is undefined.
selection_rationale: The 89-line helper is already paid off (exists, audited, works). The guard converts the silent failure into a visible warning, preventing the regression from recurring. No new dependencies. Self-contained requirement preserved.
risks: Relative path '../assets/d3-lite-force.js' breaks if the dashboard is moved — mitigated by the guard
O(N^2) charge force may slow at >500 nodes — documented follow-up to upgrade to d3-force
Label collision avoidance is complex and fragile — existing Playwright overlap detection must continue to pass
accessibility_requirements: Network nodes must have tabindex='0' for keyboard focus
Each node <g> must have aria-label with the node name
SVG must have role='img' and aria-label
Load-failure warning must have role='alert' for screen readers
performance_requirements: Force layout must complete in <100ms for 100 nodes / 260 edges
No requestAnimationFrame loop — layout is synchronous (deterministic)
data_integrity_requirements: Node and edge data comes from embedded council_candidate_inferences.json
No data is modified during layout — the helper only adds x/y coordinates
red_tests: window.d3LiteForce is defined and typeof window.d3LiteForce.layout === 'function' after page load
Node circle coordinates are NOT all on a circle (variance of distance from centroid > 5% of layout radius)
Clicking a network node updates #networkInspector with the node's name and examples
If d3-lite-force.js is removed, #networkStatus shows a visible role='alert' warning within 1 second
rollback_conditions: Remove the <script src='../assets/d3-lite-force.js'></script> tag from the generator
The circular fallback code remains in place and activates automatically
The guard becomes a no-op when window.d3LiteForce is undefined

refresh_trigger: Network exceeds 500 nodes (upgrade to real d3-force with Barnes-Hut)
Label overlap detection fails in Playwright audit
